findings.finding: No root README defines the project, status, authority path, or review route.
More than 1,100 documentation files mix foundation evidence, failed generations, current-baseline requalifications, architecture references, and closeouts without a public question-oriented index.
Qualified subsystem claims, failed integrated viability, inherited test debt, and the unstarted research frontier are not summarized in one public location.
The root has pytest configuration but no pyproject.toml, setup.py, requirements file, lockfile, or single installation contract; any README claiming a clean install would be fabricated.

The clear docs/architecture set is explicitly frozen at D-000S and contains concepts whose later implementation status differs; it is useful reference architecture but cannot be presented as an unqualified current-runtime specification.
No root LICENSE or contribution guide is present. License changes are outside REPO-001, so this remains visible follow-up debt.
Tracked source sits beside local cache directories such as .pytest_cache and __pycache__ in the working checkout; these do not belong in public navigation.

AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, COMMANDMENTS_OF_THE_CODE.md, .agent, .agents, .cursor, .serena, and .superpowers preserve governance/tool provenance. They remain in place but should not be the reader's starting point.

public_navigation_decision.justification: A separate bounded evidence guide prevents the front door from becoming a 1,100-file historical index while preserving transparent navigation to qualified and negative evidence.
